Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit (who left in 1949) and handing over to K. P. S. Menon in 1952. The team note's options don't fit this period: Pandit was already gone by 1949, and Menon took over only in 1952. I haven't re-checked sources in this turn, so the confidence reflects my recall, not a fresh lookup.

CONFIDENCE: 90
